strings.Jaga 5 sistem — tubuh adalah universe-ny: Care for 5 systems — the body is your universe.
strings.Belum ada rekor. Selesaikan run pertamam: No records yet. Finish your first run!
strings.Fraksi menentukan dashboard, hero & pasu: Factions decide your dashboard, heroes & squad — same layout, different side.
strings.Pilih sel imun-mu. Yang terkunci bisa di: Pick your immune cell. Locked ones open via mission progress or buy in the Shop.
strings.Sang Tubuh sedang sakit — bersihkan orga: The Body is sick — cleanse the organs one by one with your immune squad!
The immune system remembers your sacrifice.
strings.Tonton video singkat untuk bangkit denga: Watch a short video to revive with 50% HP and clear nearby pathogens.
strings.Tubuh ini butuh dijaga. Pilih sistem yan: This body needs care. Pick the system to restore this run — gameplay stays the same, results differ.
strings.Tiap arena punya bonus berbeda. Terbuka: Each arena has a different bonus. Unlocked by how you play.
strings.Lab Pasukan — kuatkan hero & pasukanmu d: Squad Lab — empower heroes & squad with Antibodies.
strings.Pembayaran SIMULASI — tidak ada tagihan: SIMULATED payment — no real charge. Gateway ready to hook up to a PSP.
strings.Bagian lengkap! Buka Dashboard → kartu E: Full set! Open Dashboard → Evolution card → EVOLVE.
strings.Belum punya consumable — Serum Awal ters: No consumables yet — Starter Serum is available in the Shop.
strings.Kalahkan patogen untuk mengumpulkan bagi: Defeat pathogens to collect parts — elite enemies (Virions & Parasites) drop 5x more often, bosses always drop.
strings.Evolusi maksimal — Imun Legenda sejati!: Max evolution — a true Immune Legend!
strings.Jumlah pasukan bertambah tiap bab kampan: Squad grows with each campaign chapter cleared (max 6 cells)
strings.Serum Awal aktif: +25% damage run ini!: Starter Serum active: +25% damage this run!
strings.Sinyal sitokin! Semua nutrisi tertarik p: Cytokine signal! Every nutrient is pulled toward you.
strings.Daftar/masuk dulu agar pembelian & rekor: Sign up / log in first so purchases & records are saved to your account
Save reset. A new organism forms. 🧬
strings.Tarik di layar (atau W A S D) untuk berg: Drag on screen (or W A S D) to move!
strings.Tekan tombol TEMBAK! untuk menyerang pat: Press the FIRE! button to attack pathogens!
strings.Ambil nutrisi yang jatuh: itu XP & item: Grab falling nutrients: that's XP & evolution parts!
strings.Sel T sitotoksik standar garda depan. Me: Standard cytotoxic T cell on the front line. Fires cytokine granules that pierce rows of pathogens.
strings.Sel fagosit raksasa. Mencabik semua pato: Giant phagocyte. Shreds every nearby pathogen with sweeping 137° pseudopods.
strings.Neutrophil — penjaga pertama yang paling: Neutrophil — the fastest first responder. Rapid consecutive slashes; weak alone, hungry in numbers.
strings.Memproduksi antibodi penanda yang secara: Produces marker antibodies that automatically chase the nearest pathogen wherever it hides.
strings.Natural Killer cell hiperagresif. Tebasa: Hyperaggressive Natural Killer cell. High-speed toxic slashes with narrow reach and thin HP.
strings.Spesialis anti-parasit. Meluncurkan gran: Anti-parasite specialist. Fires toxic granules that chase pathogens automatically — 1.5× damage to Parasites.
strings.Patogen dasar pengejar. Bergerak lurus m: Basic chasing pathogen. Moves straight for the nearest immune cell.
strings.Dinding sel tebal satu lapis — butuh tep: A thick single-layer cell wall — it takes extra hits to crumble. Walks slow and never gives up.
strings.Virus berduri yang menginfeksi lalu peca: A spiky virus that infects then bursts — splits into 2 tiny virions when destroyed.
strings.Partikel virus kecil hasil pembelahan. C: A tiny virus particle born from splitting. Fast and fragile.
strings.Parasit berumbai yang bergerak zig-zag m: A fringed parasite zig-zagging across the bloodstream.
strings.Spora tebal berlapis kitin. Lambat tapi: A chitin-armored spore. Slow but very tough.
strings.BOS. Sel mutan raksasa yang lambat namun: BOSS. A giant mutant cell — slow yet nearly unkillable, periodically detonating cytotoxins around it.
strings.Protozoa bersilia yang bergerak zig-zag: A ciliated protozoan that weaves side to side — hard to hit in a straight line.
strings.Berlapis membran ganda — lapisan luarnya: Wrapped in a double membrane — the outer layer absorbs one hit. Peel the patch first!
strings.Genangan racun yang diam di tempat — mel: A still poison pool — it hurts anyone who dares cross. Destroy it from a distance!
strings.Kristal salah lipat yang nyaris kebal te: A misfolded crystal nearly immune to hits — slowly turning other enemies into crystal copies!
strings.Penyamar licin — nyaris tak terlihat kec: A slick mimic — nearly invisible unless spotlighted by NK Cells. Dangerous up close!
strings.BOS. Akumulasi racun sistemik yang menje: BOSS. Systemic poison buildup embodied as a giant spiky brute — flooding the arena with toxic pools.
strings.Orb nutrisi dasar — sumber XP utama dari: Basic nutrient orb — the main XP source from destroyed pathogens.
strings.Rantai protein padat — orb XP bernilai b: A dense protein chain — a high-value XP orb.
strings.Mata uang permanen. Dipakai untuk unlock: Permanent currency. Used to unlock heroes & squad upgrades.
strings.Sinyal kimia yang menarik SEMUA nutrisi: A chemical signal that pulls EVERY nutrient on the field toward you.
strings.Telur, daging, ikan. +20 HP maksimum sam: Eggs, meat, fish. +20 max HP until the run ends.
strings.Sinar matahari & ikan berlemak. Pulihkan: Sunlight & fatty fish. Restores 1.5 HP per second all run long.
strings.Ikan laut dalam. Racun sisa combat berku: Deep-sea fish. Clears 6 leftover combat toxin per run (meta).
strings.Bayam & daging merah. +10% damage selama: Spinach & red meat. +10% damage for 20 seconds — stronger than Zinc.
strings.Yogurt & makanan fermentasi. Cooldown se: Yogurt & fermented food. Attack cooldown -15% for 25 seconds.
strings.Sayur & buah berserat. Pencernaan lancar: Leafy greens & fibrous fruit. Smooth digestion: +25% XP for 30 seconds.
strings.Air putih. Pulihkan 0,8 HP/detik sepanja: Plain water. Restores 0.8 HP per second all run — small, even regen.
strings.+25% damage untuk 1 run berikutnya (dipa: +25% damage for the next run (auto-used when the run starts)
strings.+6% damage & +8% HP per level (khusus he: +6% damage & +8% HP per level (this hero only)
strings.Pasukan menembak +12% lebih sakit & +4%: Squad shoots +12% harder & moves +4% nimbler per level
strings.Tanpa fokus khusus — semua sistem +1 saa: No special focus — all systems +1 on a win
strings.Racun dibersihkan ekstra — selamatkan Li: Extra toxin cleanse — save the Lymphatic
strings.Bersihkan 40 patogen, lalu kalahkan Raja: Clear 40 pathogens, then defeat the Inflammation King
strings.Bersihkan 55 patogen, lalu kalahkan Ibu: Clear 55 pathogens, then defeat the Parasite Mother
strings.Bersihkan 70 patogen, lalu kalahkan Ratu: Clear 70 pathogens, then defeat the Sickle Queen
strings.Bersihkan 90 patogen, lalu kalahkan Jend: Clear 90 pathogens, then defeat the Cancer General
strings.Bersihkan 120 patogen, lalu kalahkan Raj: Clear 120 pathogens, then defeat the Cancer King
strings.Sisa permen yang tak berkehendak mengund: Stray candy invites plaque bacteria to dance on the teeth. The biological alarm rings — the first immune squad marches into the Mouth Cavity!
strings.Tiba-tiba perutmu kram — sesuatu yang bu: Your belly suddenly cramps — something rotten came in with the food! Viruses rage in the Stomach. The immune one rushes in with the squad to wipe them out.
strings.Para parasit menyusup ke Lorong Berliku: Parasites sneak into the Winding Passage of the Small Intestine and feast on nutrients. The body weakens — but the immune squad keeps growing.
strings.Angin kotor masuk — Paru-paru dipenuhi v: Dirty air pours in — the Lungs fill with sickle viruses that choke every breath. Behind the haze, the immune squad lines up to clear it, one by one.
strings.Kelenjar Limfe — markas besar pasukan im: The Lymph Nodes — the immune squad's own headquarters — have been infiltrated! Pathogens nest at home. The biggest battle starts here: cleanse the base!
strings.Di pusat tubuh, Raja Kanker mencoba meng: At the body's core, the Cancer King tries to seize the Life Axis. If it falls, everything ends. The entire immune squad — every cell, one goal: A CLEAN BODY!
strings.Ikuti cerita: bersihkan organ satu per s: Follow the story: cleanse organs one by one with your immune squad. Each chapter opens when the previous one is clear.
strings.Tanpa akhir + mutator harian. Uji sebera: Endless waves + daily mutators. See how long your squad lasts.
strings.Nutrisi jatuh +35% lebih banyak, musuh s: Nutrient drops +35%, enemies a bit tougher.
strings.Musuh +20% HP, tapi nutrisi memberi +30%: Enemies +20% HP, but nutrients give +30% XP.
strings.Player -15% kecepatan gerak, +25% jangka: Player -15% move speed, +25% nutrient pickup range.
strings.Di dalam tubuh... sesuatu yang asing men: Inside the body... something alien slipped in with the food.
strings.Virus dan bakteri berkeliaran — tubuh mu: Viruses and bacteria roam free — the body starts to ache.
strings.Tapi tubuh tidak sendirian. Pasukan imun: But the body is not alone. The immune squad rises — time for battle!
strings.Tapi perjalanan belum selesai — ada orga: The journey isn't over — other organs are still waiting for help...
strings.Tombol ini membawamu ke Peta Tubuh — per: This button opens the Body Map — a journey to cleanse sick organs, one by one.
strings.Pasukanmu: pilih sel imun yang dimainkan: Your squad: pick the immune cell you play. Every hero has a different shape & attack style.
strings.Tukar antibodi hasil battle jadi hero ba: Trade battle antibodies for new heroes, permanent upgrades & supplements.
strings.Consumable & hasil perang disimpan di si: Consumables & battle loot are stored here. Check it before the next battle.
strings.5 sistem tubuh (Sirkulasi, Pencernaan, S: 5 body systems (Circulation, Digestion, Nervous, Immune, Lymphatic). Toxin wears them down — winning runs restores them. Keep them healthy!
strings.Satu tubuh, dua pasukan. Buat akunmu — p: One body, two squads. Create your account — progress, hero levels & purchases stay safe under your name.
strings.Balikkan permainan — lumpuhkan tubuh dar: Flip the game — paralyze the body from within.
strings.Bersihkan organ dari patogen sampai SEHA: Cleanse organs of pathogens back to HEALTH
strings.Ganggu organ & lolos dari kejaran imun: Disrupt organs & escape the immune chase
strings.Pelindung tubuh — basmi patogen, pulihka: Body shield — crush pathogens, restore organs.
